notes.title: Version 1.8 Released
notes.notes:
Includes the following:

+ Score system and leaderboard
+ Bonus and power items
+ Six new achievements
+ Redeveloped UI
+ Unity engine upgrade (2020.1.11f1)
+ Merchandise (link)

notes.title: Version 1.7 Released
notes.notes:
Includes the following:

+ Gold and God Toilet achievements
+ New BGM, ambience, and sound effects
+ Low quality setting lighting revisions
+ Speed boost and bug fixes
+ 3D transition scenes
+ 64-bit support

notes.title: Version 1.6 Released
notes.notes:
Includes the following:

+ Second level rework
+ Improved textures and props
+ Environmental effects
+ Occlusion culling
+ Bug and lighting fixes
+ Loading optimizations and indicators
+ Unity engine upgrade (2018.3.11f1)

notes.title: Version 1.5 Released
notes.notes:
Includes the following:

+ One new and one significantly revised level
+ Randomization of game goals on replay
+ Full rework of game post-processing
+ Mouse sensitivity control
+ New menus, displays, and credits
+ Small enhancements and bug fixes
